discovered_history_scope: Only identities actually discovered; never an exhaustive list of every transient helper ever launched
drain_contract: actual direct OS wait + complete=True + no pending exact identities + no supervisor children + EOF + every retained group observed absent within original30s
group_scan_finish_contract: Final monotonic time must be <= cleanup deadline; absence probes completing late never authorize complete drain
history_contract: count + ordered chain SHA256 + first16/last16; statuses and nonzero count retained; no invented wait0
overflow_contract: permanently incomplete; keep already-known pidfd targets signalable; continue genuine direct/adopted waits inside original cleanup allowance; no drain success
retained_group_scope: All groups of discovered owned identities retained in bounded set; only targeted signal0 ESRCH probes; no group signals
retire_only: read_stat(pid) is None OR exact PID/start differs; same-identity Z/X remain until actual reap/absence
